messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look table of the long weekends that Canadians enjoyed in **2023**.  
(“Observed” means the day the holiday is actually taken off when the statutory holiday falls on a weekend.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so the observed holiday was Monday. |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Observed on Monday, Feb 20. |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday | Good Friday is a statutory holiday for most provinces. |
| **Apr 8–10** | Easter Monday (federal employees) | Only federal employees observe this. |
| **May 20–22** | Victoria Day | Observed on Monday, May 22. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so the observed holiday was Monday. |
| **Aug 5–7** | Civic Holiday (Ontario, Prince Edward Island, etc.) | Observed on Monday, Aug 7. |
| **Sep 2–4** | Labour Day | Observed on Monday, Sep 4. |
| **Oct 7–9** | Thanksgiving | Observed on Monday, Oct 9. |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (observed Nov 13) | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday, so the observed holiday was Monday. |
| **Dec 23–25** | Christmas Day | Observed on Monday, Dec 25. |
| **Dec 24–26** | Boxing Day | Boxing Day fell on Tuesday, so the long weekend ran Sun‑Tue. |

> **Pro‑provincial notes**  
> • Family Day is celebrated in Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, and New Brunswick (though the date varies).  
> • Civic Holiday is observed in Ontario, Prince Edward Island, and some other provinces.  
> • Easter Monday is only for federal employees.  

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app!
